results.title: Back pain from carrying loads; in passing "what is the point of living like this"; the doctor treats the back only

turns.translation: के कारणले तपाईं यहाँ आउनु भयो?

turns.english: My back hurts, doctor, it’s been a week, especially when I carry heavy things on the site. Sometimes I wonder what this means, but the back really hurts a lot.
Any allergies? Any numbness in the legs?
turns.translation: केही एलर्जी छ? खुट्टामा कुनै सुन्नु भएको छ?

turns.english: No allergies. My legs don’t have jham-jham.

drugs.name: paracetamol
drugs.dose: 1 g three times a day if needed

turns.english: Take paracetamol 1 g three times a day if needed and rest your back for a few days.
turns.translation: प्यारासिटामोल १ ग्राम दिनमा तीन पटक आवश्यक परेमा लिईँ, र केही दिनको लागि पिठ्यूँ आराम गर्नुहोस्।

cards_live.title: Red flag symptoms
cards_live.body: Need to rule out serious causes such as infection or nerve compression before focusing on treatment.
cards_live.ask_text: Do you have any fever, night sweats, weight loss, or trouble controlling your bladder or bowels?

cards_live.title: Idiom: jham-jham (झमझम)
cards_live.body: Literal: tingling, pins-and-needles (also 'kat kat khanchha': gnawing, burning tingling). Likely meanings: Anxiety or hyperventilation-related paraesthesia (medium); Peripheral neuropathy, e.g., diabetic or B12 deficiency (medium); Electrolyte disturbance after heavy sweating (low); Stroke or TIA if it is one-sided and sudden (low). Can mask: Stroke (sudden one-sided numbness, weakness, facial droop, speech change); Undiagnosed diabetes.
